news.headline: Slye was able to make multiple field goals in a contest for the second time this season and for the first time since Wee
news.detail: Slye was able to make multiple field goals in a contest for the second time this season and for the first time since Week 2. The kicker converted attempts from 29 and 56 yards in the third quarter before adding makes from 49 and 44 yards in the fourth. Slye now has gone 9-for-10 on field-goal attemp
